method.alignment: Directed OSM running-track identity and official GTFS chainage, with guarded source-connected surveyed DI individual-axis XY refinement where accepted
method.integration: Each sample represents the interval to the next sample; all stop chainages are included.
method.exteriorCandidate: OSM legal lane centre on the source segment's actual station cross-section; alignment dot > 0.9; matching bridge/tunnel/layer; 2.1 m full mapped road body; outside the full track pair with 2.35 m rail clearance; no mapped building in the lane or intervening corridor. Connectivity still needs review.
method.sidewalkTramOverlap: Both directed track centres are tested against published sidewalk polygons. Nearby OSM footpaths distinguish explicit ground crossings, elevated paths and unresolved source situations. Ground crossings match within their tagged/default half-width plus 0.4 m; elevated paths within at least 3 m because bridge widths are often absent. Matched JVF 3D boundaries provide source heights; elevated paths without a qualified boundary height remain unresolved source diagnostics.
method.levelCoverage: Independent footprint lookups for each preserved JVF level; only the directed track's own level contributes to matched-level route totals. Legacy polygons without a level are identified as unspecified.
method.sourceHeightResidual: Compare the current simulated track height with a road/tram/green source boundary-interpolated surface altitude at the directed track's resolved DTM level, matching the primary rail height provider. Sidewalk-only heights do not qualify as rail heights. Interpolated interior heights are distinguished from raw measured boundary vertices.
method.railbedCoverage: Mapped road/tram/paved/maintained-green footprints count separately as physical railbed coverage. Green footprints do not create a motor road. Road/tram-centre coverage intentionally excludes genuine grassy track beds.
method.motorFallback: Allowed motor-lane centres outside all DTM footprints are counted explicitly as OSM physical-surface fallback; this source gap does not pass as verified DTM coverage and does not by itself fail the program geometry checks.
method.nativeTrackRefinement: Source-connected, position-class-3 terrestrial individual DI axes refine plan XY only. At every accepted sample the point must remain on its selected original axis (2 mm computational tolerance), within the refiner's maximum displacement, with original directed OSM identity unchanged. Route-sampled coverage uses the station integration above; sourceChainage integrates every actual refiner decision interval exactly and separately identifies inferred connectors and unchanged OSM/reference geometry. Raw fallbacks and ambiguity remain explicit; nearest-input proximity alone is not acceptance.
method.sourceHeightAcceptance: Retain original Z but reject height class 9, missing/ambiguous/nonpositive boundary heights and motor-surface boundary rises greater than 1 m with gradient above 0.2 (0.5 for parking). Quarantine a railbed surface height record if successive 2 m samples on the actual primary rail axis within the same source footprint produce an interior gradient above 0.2 per plan metre. This rejects the derived height without changing the footprint or original XYZ; the existing inferred-height fallback applies. A qualified boundary is interpolated within its source range; it does not establish a surveyed height at every interior location.
